_comment: Broadcast lower third: near-black rounded card, name over title, with a mint rounded rectangle offset 9px down-right so an accent sliver shows along the bottom and right edges. Measured off x.com/RiskReversal/status/2092685768833605757 -- the frame at t=9.0 was diffed against t=10.6 (the label's own fade-out) to isolate its pixels, which were then classified into card / accent / text. That frame is 1280x720; every number below is the reading scaled by 1.5 onto this 1920x1080 canvas, and _measured keeps the raw readings. Recolour by editing accent.colour alone -- nothing else in the design is tied to the green.

layout._note: corner is one of top-left / top-right / bottom-left / bottom-right / bottom-centre. The reference sits centre-right because its subject does; ours sits bottom-left because the speaker is framed right of centre and the multicam PiP is not up during the opening bookend.

_measured._note: The reference sets its two lines in a humanist sans (Open Sans / Noto Sans family). Montserrat is substituted here because it is what the captions and the handle badge already use, so a labelled film reads as one channel rather than two.
